**Diagnostics**

Menu → *Copy diagnostics* puts the versions, flags and paths on your clipboard — versions and
paths only, no history, no bookmarks, no URLs. Paste it here.

`%AppData%\Nibble\nibble.log` only gets written when something throws; if it exists, its last
few lines usually say what went wrong.

**Screenshots or a recording**

If it is a visual glitch, a short recording shows it far better than words.
